title: Return Merchandise Dispatch Sheet Form
subtitle: Turn the return merchandise request into a capacity-checked manifest, assigned route, custody plan, handling controls, exception path, and authorized release.
description: An original, fillable return merchandise dispatch sheet form for controlling returned product, return authorization, and disposition unit through dispatch sheet identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use before return receipt, inspection, credit, repair, and disposition when the returns authorization coordinator, returns receiving and inspection associate, and receiving owner need one executable dispatch record from commitment through manifest, sequence, variance management, and return handoff.

sections.title: Return Merchandise dispatch sheet identity and routing
sections.guidance: Anchor the record to the exact work, parties, locations, and source references.

fields.label: Return authorization and original order number
SKU, serial, lot, package, or return-label ID

blocks.label: Responsible parties and route points

fields.label: Customer, store, field location, or return carrier
Returns dock, quarantine area, repair, restock, or supplier route

blocks.guidance: Preserve linkage to the return authorization, original sale, product identity, and return policy.

sections.title: Return Merchandise service commitment and assignment
sections.guidance: Convert the request into an executable assignment with clear timing, capacity, and accountable custody.

blocks.label: Return Merchandise dispatch readiness
items: Return authorization, original transaction, customer, and item are matched
Permitted quantity, return reason, return window, and routing are explicit
Serial, lot, warranty, ownership, and recall status can be verified
Required accessories, packaging, manuals, keys, or components are identified
Data-bearing, hazardous, contaminated, food, and temperature-sensitive items are routed
Carrier label, pickup method, and receiving destination are correct
Refund, replacement, repair, restock, supplier return, and disposal authority are separated
Fraud, privacy, safety, and unresolved-condition escalation is assigned
blocks.guidance: Resolve failed readiness controls before authorization or record the approved alternate.

fields.label: Assigned vehicle, equipment, or work area

sections.title: Return Merchandise dispatch manifest and control assignment
sections.guidance: Tie each movement unit to its quantity, custody, destination, and handling control.

blocks.label: Returned Items, Serials, Lots, Accessories, Packages, And Disposition Quantities dispatch manifest

columns.label: SKU, serial, lot, package, or return-label ID
Authorized, received, accepted, and disposition quantity

sections.title: Return Merchandise route, sequence, and custody plan
sections.guidance: Plan each control point and define the handoff evidence before execution begins.

blocks.label: Route, work sequence, and handoff plan
Return Merchandise assigned handling controls
items: Quarantine pending inspection

Temperature-sensitive return hold
Original packaging preservation
Accessory and component reconciliation
Supplier return authorization required
No credit before disposition approval

blocks.label: Access, loading, custody, contingency, and return instructions

fields.label: Access, loading, custody, contingency, and return instructions

blocks.guidance: Write only instructions the assignee cannot reliably infer from labels, route data, or standard procedure.

sections.title: Return Merchandise exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Return Merchandise exception indicators
items: No valid return authorization or item outside approved scope
SKU, serial, lot, ownership, or original transaction cannot be matched
Received quantity or accessories differ from the return request
Undisclosed use, damage, contamination, modification, or missing parts
Hazardous, leaking, swollen, sharp, or otherwise unsafe condition
Data-bearing device lacks approved privacy handling
Temperature control or product integrity cannot be established
Warranty, recall, return-window, or policy status is disputed
Customer remedy and physical disposition conflict
Duplicate credit, replacement, or return record is suspected
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Dispatch variance, alternate assignment, or stop-work decision

sections.title: Return Merchandise dispatch authorization and release
sections.guidance: Release only the reconciled scope and record restrictions that continue into execution.

fields.label: Returns, Quality, Or Finance Supervisor review

sections.title: Return Merchandise dispatch sheet closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: Use this return merchandise dispatch sheet with the applicable customer commitment, carrier terms, site policy, and retention requirements. Do not infer acceptance or release from a signature alone; unresolved identity, count, condition, custody, or proof issues require an owner, escalation, and documented disposition.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by returns, quality, or finance supervisor

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
